text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy finished: canary rollout completed for tag v3.2.1 -> prod (model: rwd-7b-q4). Observability: spike in inference errors on /v1/generate. Tokenization exceptions observed. Paging @oncall-miguel

oncall-miguel: Ack, I'm on it. How widespread? Any customer reports?

meera: Logs show repeated tokenizer decode errors and weight shape warnings.
```
2026-03-15T16:12:05Z ERROR tokenizer: decode failed: Unknown token id 50256
2026-03-15T16:12:06Z WARN weights: layer0 size mismatch expected=32768 got=32760
```
Looks like the deployed weight bundle doesn't match the tokenizer config.

ben: Confirmed release used artifact tags: weights=weights-2026-03-15-v2 tokenizer=tokenizer-v2.json. Build metadata shows a mismatch during packaging step — probably the wrong tokenizer file got bundled.

sam: I'm going to disable the new tokenizer flag across canaries and trigger a rollback if that doesn't normalize traffic. /featureflag disable use-new-tokenizer --env=prod

deploy-bot: Feature flag update: use-new-tokenizer -> false (in progress). Updating 12 canary hosts (85% complete).

support-bot: Customer alerts: 4 active reports. 2 enterprise customers see malformed completions (high), 1 is service-affecting. Tickets #INC-4231, #INC-4232 escalated to CSE.

anya: Reached out to impacted customers with a heads-up; ETA 30m for full mitigation. Collecting logs from them now.

meera: Rollback initiated: /rollout rollback --to-tag=weights-2026-03-12-stable. Rolling back weights and forcing tokenizer config to stable. ETA ~8m.

sam: Adding rollback note to release: rollback triggered due to tokenizer/weights mismatch; cutting new release to verify packaging.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. weights-2026-03-12-stable applied to all prod nodes. Error rate returned to baseline (~1.0x). KV/cache priming back to normal.

ryan: Taking handoff for validation and postmortem. I'll run the smoke suite against affected endpoints and validate customer reprocases. Please drop any artifacts and logs in the incident folder.

meera: Smoke tests green, tokenizer decode errors gone. Replaying problematic requests from logs; results look normal. Marking immediate mitigation done.

sam: Filing a hotfix: pipeline check to validate tokenizer+weights packaging. Will include checksum guard and release artefact audit in CI.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1749999999 | Severity: P2 | Actions: featureflag disable, rollback to stable weights, customer notifications. Assigned: meera, sam. Handoff to ryan for follow-up and postmortem. :memo:

anya: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and share post-mortem when available.

meera: Next steps: root cause triage (packaging pipeline), CI guard, telemetry alert tuning for tokenization anomalies. ETA for full RCA: 72h.

ryan: Received handoff. Will own postmortem and action items. Ping me for anything else. :thumbsup:
